product_metadata.title: Avocado Dicer
features: ✅ NEWEST AVOCADO tool on the market – grab an avocado, slice in half, push pitted avocado half down on the stainless grid, and twist to get perfect avocado cubes every time.
✅ AVOCADO CUBES are perfect for all of your favorite recipes like avocado toast, guacamole, add on’s for tacos, wraps, sandwiches, and more.
✅ EASY TO USE – Ergonomic grip makes it easy to dice and cube avocados like a professional.
✅ HIGH QUALITY MATERIALS - Durable BPA free ABS plastic handle with strong premium stainless steel construction.
✅ EASY TO CLEAN – easily rinses clean and is top shelf dishwasher safe.
description: The perfect avocado every time! This tool is essential for quickly cutting equal-sized cubes of avocado for adding to salads, sushi, and other dishes, or simply prepping avocados for making guacamole and all your favorite avocado recipes.
A New Easy Twist on Serving Fresh Avocado!
